subject: Benchmark run playbook + evidence handback for ClearHQ onboard
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@clearhq.com>
Cc: Tina Wong <tina.w@clearhq.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Benchmark run playbook + evidence handback for ClearHQ onboard

Hi Jared / Tina,

Following our discovery call last week, attached is the run-playbook we propose for the production-acceptance benchmark. The goal is to validate tail-latency and steady-state throughput under representative traffic and the KV/prefix caching behavior you described. High-level targets we agreed on:

- 99th percentile latency <= 220ms for 1–2 token prompts
- 95th percentile latency <= 150ms for typical prompts (avg length ~32 tokens)
- Sustained throughput target: 650 reqs/min with 8 concurrent workers
- Cold-start window: first 60s allowed for startup variance

What I'm asking from you to lock the run:
1) Confirm preferred test window (we've penciled Wed 7/4 02:00–05:00 PT).
2) Provide a service account or temporary API key we can use for a non-prod gateway test (scoped, short-lived).
3) Any additional traffic slices we should include (e.g., long-context prompts, embedding-only calls).

Attachments: clearhq-run-plan-v1.xlsx (run steps + metrics map), traffic-profile-stage.json (traffic generator config).

If you confirm today, Ben and I will spin up the dedicated harness, run a dry warmup, and deliver the evidence bundle (CSV + annotated logs) and a short executive one-pager.

Thanks,
Priya
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

- Wed 7/4 02:00–05:00 PT works for our infra (overnight maintenance window).

Team — forwarding ClearHQ confirmation and asks. Action items:

- Ben: lead the run, ensure the traffic generator includes the 1% long-context slice and ramp profile. Capture 1s-resolution tail latencies and per-model KV-cache hit/miss counts.
- Monica: please set up the Drive folder (see related_links) and pre-create the results CSV template (latency percentiles, p50/p95/p99, errors, 429 counts).

Thanks,
Priya
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 00:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Benchmark run playbook + evidence handback for ClearHQ onboard

Quick run update and checklist before we start:

- Warmup plan: gradual ramp 0 -> 650 reqs/min over 15 minutes, 8 concurrent workers. Warmup will exercise model cache and KV prefetch.
- Long-context slice: implemented per Priya — generator will insert 2k-token contexts for 1% of requests and then a short rerank pass.
- Rate-limiter: Dev validated harness honors burst=120rps; we will send bursts during warmup but throttle strictly once steady-state is reached. We will capture any 429s with reason codes.
- Instrumentation: collecting per-token latency traces, model-side queue lengths, and server-side cache hit/miss counters. Logs will be annotated with request_id and run_id.

Artifacts to be uploaded into Drive once run completes: latency-throughput-summary.csv, kv-cache-evidence.txt, annotated-traces.zip (links in Drive).

If everything is green I'll post the preliminary summary to the Drive link and ping Priya to share with ClearHQ.

Ben
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: latency-throughput-summary.csv (text/csv stub)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@clearhq.com>, Tina Wong <tina.w@clearhq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Benchmark run playbook + evidence handback for ClearHQ onboard

Hi Jared / Tina —

Run completed. Key outcomes (executive summary):

- Steady-state throughput: 660 reqs/min sustained (8 workers).
- Latency: p50 = 34ms, p95 = 132ms, p99 = 198ms (meets the 220ms p99 target).
- 429s observed: 7 total during warmup only; all tagged as "burst_limit" and occurred within the first 90s. No 429s during steady-state.
- Long-context slice: added overhead as expected — median latency for 2k-token requests = 720ms; we recommend a separate SLA for those calls or using a dedicated queue if ClearHQ requires p99 < 1s.
- KV cache: overall hit rate 78% during steady-state; we attached kv-cache-evidence.txt with sample keys and timestamps.

Artifacts uploaded: latency-throughput-summary.csv, kv-cache-evidence.txt, annotated-traces.zip (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq_example_run_artifacts). HubSpot record HS-93492 updated with run notes and attachments.

Recommended next steps:
1) Review the one-pager (first file in Drive) with your SRE; let us know if you want a short joint walkthrough.
2) If you want sub-200ms p99 for long-context calls, we can scope a dedicated model-queue test (est. 2–3 weeks).
3) Accept the run evidence and we will mark the onboarding performance gate complete.

Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Priya
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
